description: This file defines the 'Reviewer' entity class for the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It models the reviewer object, including properties such as status, completion date, comments, and relationships to ratings, groups, reviews, and employees. The class is annotated with ORM mappings for database persistence and employs a decorator pattern.

classes.name: Reviewer
classes.description: Entity class representing a reviewer in the HRM system, with properties for status, completed date, comment, and relationships to ratings, group, review, and employee.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the reviewer.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the reviewer.

methods.name: getCompletedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the review was completed.

methods.name: setCompletedDate
methods.description: Sets the completion date of the review.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the comment associated with the reviewer.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the comment for the reviewer.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Retrieves the group the reviewer belongs to.

methods.name: setGroup
methods.description: Assigns a group to the reviewer.

methods.name: setReview
methods.description: Associates a performance review with the reviewer.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Assigns an employee to the reviewer.
